scripts.prebuild: echo 'Skipping sitemap generation - using manual sitemap.xml'
scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const files=['robots.txt','sitemap.xml','_headers','_redirects'];const src='public',dst='dist';fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of files){const s=path.join(src,f),d=path.join(dst,f);if(fs.existsSync(s)){fs.copyFileSync(s,d);}}"
scripts.check:admin: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.admin.json && eslint src/admin/AdminGate.tsx src/admin/AdminPanel.tsx src/admin/Login.tsx src/admin/studio src/admin/utils/convertToWebP.ts src/App.tsx
scripts.check:security: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext netlify/functions/sendTelegram.ts && eslint netlify/functions/sendTelegram.ts && node --test tests/security.mjs && node tests/scan-secrets.mjs
